title: ontoforge definition document
description: An ObjectType, LinkType, ActionType or SourceBinding document (ADR-0012, ADR-0021), selected by its `kind`; JSON files may hold an array of them.

Definition.description: One definition document: an ObjectType, LinkType, ActionType or SourceBinding, selected by `kind`.

oneOf.description: A kind of object, for example `Flight`.

apiName.description: Unique `PascalCase` name used in code, APIs and references.

aliases.description: Alternative names, used for search and by agents.

hidden.description: Hide the object type from default listings.

backing.description:
Where the objects come from. Required: `source` needs a source binding in
the selected profile, `editOnly` must have none (D-02).

primaryKey.description:
Property that uniquely identifies an object. It must be declared in
`properties`, set `required: true`, and be a string, integer or short
(other types are discouraged or invalid).

titleKey.description: Property used as the object's title; defaults to `primaryKey`.

properties.description: Properties keyed by their camelCase apiName.

oneOf.description:
A relationship between two object types, for example `Airport` to `Flight`.

Both ends are written in the link type. An end's `apiName` is the accessor on
that end's own `objectType` that reaches the other end. This is the reverse of
how Foundry words it, where the name written on one end lives on the opposite
object type.

apiName.description: Unique `camelCase` name; actions refer to the link by it.

backing.description:
Where the link rows come from. Required for `manyToMany`; not allowed for
`oneToOne` and `oneToMany`, which follow the foreign key on the `to` end.

from.description: The first end. In `oneToMany` this is the "one" side.

to.description:
The second end. In `oneToMany` this is the "many" side and holds the
foreign key.

oneOf.description: A named, validated change to the object graph.

apiName.description: Unique `camelCase` name; callers and agents invoke the action by it.

parameters.description: Inputs, keyed by their camelCase apiName.

rules.description:
Edits applied in order; the order is significant and at least one rule is
required. Each rule is written `kind: <ruleKind>` followed by its fields.

submissionCriteria.description: Conditions that must hold before the rules run.

oneOf.description:
Binds one object type or one many-to-many link to a physical table or view.

The profile is not written in the document: it is the name of the directory
the file sits in, `bindings/<profile>/`.

target.description:
What is bound: `{ objectType: Flight }` or `{ linkType: flightCrew }`. Only
`manyToMany` links can be bound.

source.description: The physical table or view the target reads from.

columns.description:
Column mappings that differ from the default. Keys are property apiNames for
an object type, or `from` and `to` for a link. A property that is not listed
is read from the column of the same name (D-03).

fixture.description:
Sample rows that stand in for the table when no Trino is available; used
only by the SQLite stand-in engine.

Backing.description: The data source an object type or many-to-many link declares.

oneOf.description:
Objects come from the physical table bound for the selected profile; edits
are layered on top.
Objects are created only through actions or imports. No binding is allowed.

PropertyDef.description: One property of an object type.

type.description: Base type of the property value.

required.description: Whether every object must have a value.

items.description: Element type; required when `type` is `array`, not allowed otherwise.

precision.description:
Total number of digits of a `decimal` (or of an `array` of `decimal`).
Defaults to 38 (ADR-0015, ADR-0021).

scale.description:
Number of digits after the decimal point of a `decimal` (or of an `array`
of `decimal`). Defaults to 10 (ADR-0015, ADR-0021).

Cardinality.description: How many objects each side of a link may relate to.

oneOf.description:
One `from` object relates to at most one `to` object, and the other way round.
The `to` end carries the foreign key.

One `from` object relates to many `to` objects. The `to` end carries the
foreign key.

Many objects on each side. The system manages a join table, so no foreign
key is written.

LinkEnd.description: One end of a link type.

objectType.description: The object type at this end.

apiName.description:
The accessor on this end's `objectType` that reaches the other end. It must
be unique among that object type's accessors and must not equal one of its
properties.

displayName.description: Human-readable name of the accessor shown in UIs.

foreignKey.description:
Property holding the reference. Only on the `to` end of `oneToOne` and
`oneToMany`; it must be a property of the `to` object type whose type equals
the `from` object type's primary key type. Never written for `manyToMany`.

type.description: A base type, or `{ objectReference: <ObjectType> }` for an existing object.

items.description: Element type; required when `type` is `array`, not allowed otherwise.

required.description: Whether the caller must supply a value.

default.description:
Value used when the caller supplies none. Must be a valid literal of the
parameter type; not allowed for object references.

ParamType.description: The type of a parameter: one of the thirteen base types or an object reference.

oneOf.description: An existing object of this type, written `{ objectReference: Flight }`.

Rule.description: One edit of an action, selected by `kind`. Rules run in list order.

oneOf.description: Create a new object.

properties.description: Property values. The primary key and every required property must appear.

oneOf.description: Change properties of an existing object passed as a parameter.

object.description: Name of an `objectReference` parameter holding the object to change.

properties.description: Property values to set. The primary key cannot be set.

oneOf.description: Delete an existing object passed as a parameter.

object.description: Name of an `objectReference` parameter holding the object to delete.

oneOf.description: Link two existing objects.

from.description: `objectReference` parameter for the link's `from` object type.

to.description: `objectReference` parameter for the link's `to` object type.

oneOf.description: Unlink two existing objects.

from.description: `objectReference` parameter for the link's `from` object type.

to.description: `objectReference` parameter for the link's `to` object type.

ValueSource.description: Where a property value comes from, written as a single-key map.

oneOf.description: The value of a parameter: `{ param: name }`.
A literal: `{ static: value }`. `null` is not allowed.
The calling user's id, for string properties: `{ currentUser: {} }`.
The time of the call, for timestamp properties: `{ currentTime: {} }`.

Empty.description: The empty mapping `{}`; no fields are accepted.

SubmissionCriterion.description: A condition checked before the rules run.

condition.description: A CEL expression over `params`, `user` and `objects` that must be true.

failureMessage.description: Shown to the caller when the condition is false.

BindingTarget.description:
What a [`SourceBinding`] binds. Externally tagged so that error paths survive
deserialization (ADR-0003).

oneOf.description: An object type, by its `PascalCase` apiName.
A many-to-many link type, by its `camelCase` apiName.

SourceRef.description:
A physical table or view in the data source.

It is one table or view. To combine several tables, create a view in Trino and
bind that (D-04).

ColumnBinding.description: How one property (or one link end) maps to a column.

column.description: Physical column name. Defaults to the property apiName (D-03).

timezone.description:
IANA time zone name for a timestamp column that carries no zone, for
example `Europe/Berlin`; write `aware` when the column already has one
(ADR-0021).

collation.description: How string comparison treats case on this column.

Collation.description: String comparison semantics of a column.

oneOf.description: Upper and lower case letters differ.
Upper and lower case letters compare equal.

FixtureRef.description: Sample rows for the stand-in engine.

file.description:
Path relative to the directory of the binding file. Only `.csv` and `.json`
files inside the ontology directory are accepted.
